definitions.gloss: despite; in spite of; although; even though
definitions.explanation: Formal expression for contrast between expectation and reality.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧にも{関|かか}わらず、⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Despite the rain, the match was held.

examples.japanese: ⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧にも{関|かか}わらず、⟦{手伝|てつだ}って→手伝う：00898_tetsudau⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: Although she was busy, she helped me.

examples.japanese: ⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧にも{関|かか}わらず、⟦また→また：00969_mata⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Despite being warned, he made the same mistake again.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧にも{関|かか}わらず、⟦{本番|ほんばん}→本番：19392_honban⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦しまった→仕舞う：03064_shimau⟧。
examples.english: Despite practicing many times, I failed during the actual performance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{若|わか}い→若い：00823_wakai⟧にも{関|かか}わらず、⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{任|まか}されている→任せる：02417_makaseru⟧。
examples.english: Despite being young, he has been entrusted with major work at the company.

notes:
にも{関|かか}わらず expresses that the result is contrary to what would be expected given the circumstances. It is more formal than ⟦のに→のに：10529_noni⟧ and emphasizes the unexpected contrast.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- [noun] + にも{関|かか}わらず: ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧にも{関|かか}わらず (despite the rain)
- [verb plain form] + にも{関|かか}わらず: ⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧にも{関|かか}わらず (despite warning)
- [i-adjective] + にも{関|かか}わらず: ⟦{若|わか}い→若い：00823_wakai⟧にも{関|かか}わらず (despite being young)
- [na-adj + な/⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧] + にも{関|かか}わらず: ⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧にも{関|かか}わらず (despite being healthy)

REGISTER:
Formal/written. Common in news, essays, and business. In casual speech, ⟦のに→のに：10529_noni⟧ is preferred.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦のに→のに：10529_noni⟧: although (casual, spoken — often implies frustration or regret, which にも{関|かか}わらず does not: it simply records the contrast)
- ⟦けれども→けれども：02995_keredomo⟧ / ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧: but (neutral connectors)
- ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧にも{関|かか}わらず: nevertheless (sentence-initial form, linking back to the previous sentence)

WRITING:
Frequently written all in kana as にもかかわらず; official style guides in fact prefer the kana form, since {関|かん} is not the standard kanji for かかわる in this expression. Both are common in print.
